title: Visiting SpaceX & Meeting Elon Musk [Munro Clip]
summary: A clip of Sandy Munro, a veteran automotive engineer, describing his visit to a SpaceX Starship design review and meeting Elon Musk. He says he was struck by how deeply Musk is involved in engineering.
why: Used as a neutral outsider's first-hand account of SpaceX's fast engineering culture and Musk's hands-on role.

quote.text: Sandy Munro was invited to SpaceX design review session, so he has some first-hand comments about that
